# Repository Instructions

- This repository contains an Android client in `client/android` and a FastAPI backend in `server`.
- Use Android Studio's bundled JDK for Android builds.
- Validate Android changes with `client/android/gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug`.
- Retain and cancel Retrofit calls when an Android Activity is destroyed.
- Install the highlight scheduler before autoplay starts so early highlight windows are not skipped.
- The backend scans real local drama files from `LOCAL_DRAMA_ROOT`. Do not add fake drama seed data.
- Use `ffprobe` or `FFPROBE_PATH` to read real episode durations.
- Restrict media routes to supported extensions and paths inside the configured drama root.
- Validate backend changes with `server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s server/tests -v`.
- Keep generated files, virtual environments, caches, APKs, and video files out of Git.
